verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents API versioning (version paths, headers, or changelogs) or a formal deprecation policy. The only deprecation mention is a rebrand notice that Brand.dev domains and package names are deprecated. That notice and the published OpenAPI spec are adjacent material, not a versioning or deprecation policy, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
